title: Lakebase now in Public Preview
body: Lakebase is now in Public Preview on AWS. This new version of Lakebase introduces autoscaling compute, scale-to-zero, database branching, instant restore, and a redesigned project-based interface. To allow users to explore the new version, usage of Lakebase is free for a limited time. Billing for Lakebase usage begins in January 2026. See [Get started with Lakebase Postgres](/aws/en/oltp/projects/get-started).
